name: Molestation
overview: Scripture condemns the act of molestation as a grievous offense, particularly highlighting the protection of the vulnerable, such as betrothed women and children who believe in Christ. Deuteronomy 22:25 prescribes severe consequences for a man who forcibly lies with a betrothed woman, emphasizing the seriousness of such sin. The New Testament further underscores the gravity of harming children, warning that it would be better for the offender to suffer a millstone-hung death than to cause them to stumble (Matthew 18:6; Mark 9:42; Luke 17:2). Believers are called to walk in the Spirit to resist the lusts of the flesh, which include sexual sins such as uncleanness and lasciviousness (Galatians 5:16,19).
